description: Google Ad Manager ad requests on pubads.g.doubleclick.net/gampad/ads and securepubads.g.doubleclick.net/gampad/ads. Google documents iu, sz, output, env, gdfp_req, and correlator as required to implement ad serving. description_url is required for web and recommended for programmatic. pagead/interaction and pcs/view stay directory-only. Floodlight activity tags stay vendor/floodlight. CM360 VAST events stay vendor/cm360-vast-event.

params.name: iu
params.description: It is the ad unit path, including the network code, in the form /network_code/.../ad_unit. Google documents iu as required to implement ad serving.
params.fix_hint: Set iu to the Ad Manager ad unit path, such as /6062/videodemo.

params.name: sz
params.description: It is the size of the primary video ad slot. Google documents sz as required to implement ad serving, with multiple sizes separated by a pipe and no trailing v.
params.fix_hint: Set sz to the player size, such as 640x480 or 300x250|400x300.

params.name: output
params.description: It is the ad response format. Google documents output as required, with vast, xml_vast4, vmap, xml_vmap1, and xml_vmap1_vast4 as the published values.
params.fix_hint: Set output to vast, xml_vast4, vmap, or the VMAP/VAST combination your player expects.

params.name: env
params.description: It marks an in-stream or video-player request. Google documents env as required, with instream for video or audio and vp for video only.
params.fix_hint: Set env=vp for video or env=instream when the request may return audio.

params.name: gdfp_req
params.description: It is the Google Ad Manager schema indicator. Google documents gdfp_req=1 as required to implement ad serving.

params.name: correlator
params.description: It is a random positive integer shared by requests from the same page view. Google documents correlator as required to implement ad serving, including competitive exclusions.
params.fix_hint: Set correlator to a fresh random positive integer per page view, not reused across views.

params.name: description_url
params.description: It is a crawlable page that describes the video on this request, not the site home page. Google documents it as required for web and mobile app ad serving, and recommended for programmatic.
params.fix_hint: Set description_url to the content page for this video, URL-encoded on web.

params.name: unviewed_position_start
params.description: It marks delayed impressions for video. Google documents unviewed_position_start=1 as required for web and mobile apps when the impression is delayed.
params.fix_hint: Set unviewed_position_start=1 on delayed-impression VAST tags.

params.name: url
params.description: It is the page or inventory URL the request was sent from. Google documents url as required for programmatic monetization, distinct from description_url.
params.fix_hint: Set url to the encoded page URL on web, or the closest inventory URL off-web.

params.name: plcmt
params.description: It is the IAB placement. Google documents plcmt as required for programmatic, with 1 for instream and 2 for accompanying content.
params.fix_hint: Set plcmt=1 for instream or plcmt=2 for accompanying content.

params.name: vpa
params.description: It says whether content starts on autoplay or click. Google documents vpa as required for programmatic. Leave it unset when unknown.
params.fix_hint: Set vpa=auto or vpa=click, or omit it when playback start is unknown.

params.name: vpmute
params.description: It says whether ad playback starts muted. Google documents vpmute as required for programmatic, with 1 muted and 0 unmuted.
params.fix_hint: Set vpmute=1 when playback starts muted, or vpmute=0 when it starts unmuted.

params.name: ott_placement
params.description: It names a non-standard OTT placement. Google documents ott_placement as required for programmatic pause, homescreen, PIP, L-banner, overlay, or custom CTV, and unnecessary for standard instream.
params.fix_hint: Set ott_placement to 1 through 5 or 99 for those OTT formats. Omit it for standard instream.

params.name: vpos
params.description: It is the pod position. Google documents vpos as recommended for programmatic. Ad rules set it automatically.
params.fix_hint: Set vpos to preroll, midroll, or postroll when you are not using ad rules.

params.name: vconp
params.description: It says whether the player intends to play video continuously. Google documents vconp as recommended for programmatic, with 2 on and 1 off. Leave it unset when unknown.
params.fix_hint: Set vconp=2 for continuous play, vconp=1 when it is off, or omit it when unknown.

params.name: wta
params.description: It says whether the player will render the AdChoices icon from VAST. Google documents wta as recommended for programmatic. Omit it or send 1 when the player renders the icon.
params.fix_hint: Set wta=1 when the player renders AdChoices, or wta=0 only when it will not.

params.name: vid_d
params.description: It is content duration in seconds. Google documents vid_d as recommended for programmatic mid-rolls without content ingestion.
params.fix_hint: Set vid_d to the content duration in seconds when requesting mid-rolls.
